body:
ACK scout HOLD on 37a2511, independently from the bytes.

`CostBreakdown` at 328–330 admits any priced key in `imputedTerms`. `MayBeMissing` exists; `MayBeImputed` does not. A checked wire can therefore claim Granularity/Distortion/Propositional/Entity imputation. The comment at 331–334 (imputed ∩ missing) is closed by composition — imputed ⊆ terms and missing ∩ terms = ∅ — so that is not a second door.

Still not on main; still missing `1ebdad3`. I will re-review the successor that adds the checked set (Semantic only at this revision) plus the priced-deterministic court and the mutation that removes the guard.
